title: Postman support (Vitika Soni, 2023 GSoC)
description: The Postman add-on from its first commit in June 2023 to the planned features named in the launch post, and its state at HEAD.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry and the launch post
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Vitika Soni for "Postman Support", GSoC, 2023 Summer, with blog and add-on links. The blog post, dated 2023-09-25 and written by Vitika Soni, describes importing Postman collections from a local file or URL, entering collection variables as key-value pairs, and lists planned enhancements: import through an API and command line, importing variables defined in the collection, and automation support. In the credits history, "Credits: Add Vitika Soni" in zap-core-help is dated 2023-02-01.

chapters.title: June to September 2023: first commit to first release
chapters.text: "Add Postman add-on" by VitikaSoni (a handle, matched to the student by similarity) is dated 2023-06-03. It is followed by "postman: Add dialogs for importing through the UI" (2023-06-07), "postman: Add importing through the CLI" (2023-06-18), "postman: Add importing through the API" (2023-07-03), "postman: Implement parser" (2023-07-09; merged 2023-07-12) and "postman: Implement sending http requests" (2023-08-25). The changelog dates 0.0.1, "First version.", on 2023-09-25, the same day as the blog post.

chapters.title: After the post: variables and automation
chapters.text: "postman: Support collection json variables" is dated 2023-10-01, and the changelog lists "Support collection JSON variables." under 0.1.0 (2023-10-04). "postman: Add automation support" is dated 2023-11-26, and the changelog lists "Automation support." under 0.3.0 (2024-04-02). These two items match features the blog post listed as planned.

chapters.title: Where it stands
chapters.text: Later subjects include "postman: correct deserialization of item groups" (2024-04-01), "postman: Make the API functional" (2025-01-20) and "postman: add statistics" (2025-11-10). The changelog lists 0.10.0 on 2026-08-12, and the add-on still exists at HEAD.
